doc: The Search Box component allows users to input queries and find relevant results within an application or website. It typically includes a text input field. When users start typing, a delete icon appears, allowing them to quickly clear the input. Additionally, a trailing icon with a tooltip is displayed, which shows more information when the user hovers over it or presses the tab key, helping clarify the button's function. This enhances usability and accessibility, providing a more intuitive user experience.
